Name: Drone Defender (Beta)
Author: PrinceAstero
Description:
Description 🛡️
Drone Defender is a from-scratch combat companion mod for Stardew Valley 1.6.
Your personal defense drone follows you everywhere, automatically detects nearby monsters, and provides aerial fire support while you farm, mine, or explore. Built for SDV 1.6 with multiplayer and customization in mind.
Why I made this: I play split-screen co-op with my 12-year-old daughter, and she was scared of dying alone in the mines. I built Drone Defender from the ground up with full multiplayer support so she can explore safely with her own bodyguard. Now she mines confidently while I’m farming 😊
[i]Inspired by the combat companion concept popularized by Combat Drone by cotboy and Combat Drone Redux by klatuprism. This is a complete rewrite with original code, assets, and features.[/i]
Installation instructions 📥
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI - [url=https://l.meta.ai/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fsmapi.io%2F&h=AUDT3-RpfsfSEEw46Db2FnlD-eRfwyDI0B7d5MK1a3dd2yk7ZfY4obUy556CtPjIFODO61ifkS8EDmQlA1OYkX1FUz0NFdKXHdq5OJ9W2qczQ7RxZv4GYK7ppaM-arSBCkXTgQHaKJrnqisXMYAmKA]https://smapi.io[/url][/*]
[*]Download and unzip this mod[/*]
[*]Move the 
[code]DroneDefender[/code] folder into your 
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI[/*]
[*]Optional: Install Generic Mod Config Menu to adjust settings in-game[/*]
[/list]Main features ✨
[list]
[*]⚔️ Auto-Defense: Detects and attacks monsters automatically within your custom range[/*]
[*]🏠 Farm Safe**: Smart targeting ignores your Slimes inside the Slime Hutch so you won't hurt your ranch [/*]
[*]🎨 20 Projectile Types: Choose from fireballs, arrows, bullets, slime, ice, and more - each with unique sounds[/*]
[*]✨ Smooth Animations: Animated drone with natural hovering movement[/*]
[*]👥 Split-Screen Ready: Full multiplayer support so every farmer gets their own defender[/*]
[*]🎮 Deep Customization: Tweak damage, range, cooldown, speed, distance, and visuals via GMCM[/*]
[*]🌐 Translation Ready: Full i18n support for all projectile names and settings[/*]
[*]🔧 Player Friendly: Enable/disable anytime, balance from "helpful buddy" to "overpowered guardian"[/*]
[*]👨‍👧 Family Friendly: Perfect for younger players who want to explore without the stress[/*]
[/list]Requirements 📋
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, but highly recommended)[/*]
[/list]Permissions & Credits 📜
This mod is released under the MIT License. You are free to use, modify, and redistribute it. Credit is appreciated but not required.
Source Code: [url=https://github.com/AsteroPrince/Stardew-Valley/tree/main/DroneDefender]GitHub[/url]
Inspiration & Thanks: This mod was inspired by the combat companion concept from Combat Drone by cotboy and Combat Drone Redux by klatuprism. Shout out to yllhwa/murderdrone for showing 1.6 compatibility is possible. All code and assets in Drone Defender are original.
